name: Result Panel
summary: A result panel is what an action produced — a built URL, a key, a receipt — with a button to copy it. It is made almost entirely of other components, and each of them can announce on its own, so the work is deciding that only the panel speaks and everything inside it stays quiet.
demoNote: Examples 2 to 5 are live. Example 2 measures how narrow the same URL is willing to be under three wrapping rules; example 3 builds one link into two panels and counts what a screen reader was handed by each; example 4 has three copy buttons reporting the same copy three ways; example 5 presses Copy on a panel that has nothing in it.
